# ElizaOS Daily Project Summary (Aug 21, 2026)

Development on August 21 focused on hardening the ElizaOS framework through critical security upgrades, including the implementation of Unicode-safe string handling and the replacement of backtracking regexes with linear-time scanners. The team also expanded the ecosystem's integration capabilities by introducing a managed-provider adapter SDK and finalizing infrastructure for credential management and billing lifecycles.

## ✅ Completed Work

### Framework Security & Hardening
*   **Unicode Safety:** Deployed `toWellFormedUnicode` and `truncateWellFormed` across core modules to prevent surrogate pair corruption during string truncation ([elizaos/eliza#23777](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23777), [elizaos/eliza#23748](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23748), [elizaos/eliza#23684](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23684)).
*   **Injection Prevention:** Replaced backtracking SQL regexes with a single-pass lexer and transitioned to deterministic, linear-time cursor scans to secure data processing ([elizaos/eliza#23153](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23153), [elizaos/eliza#23347](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23347)).
*   **Credential Management:** Established a Vault workspace and a Cloud credential broker to centralize and secure connection IDs ([elizaos/eliza#23068](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23068), [elizaos/eliza#23149](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23149)).

### Infrastructure & Managed Adapters
*   **Provider SDK:** Introduced a reusable managed-provider adapter SDK, including specific implementations for Google Maps, Notion, Dropbox, and Spotify ([elizaos/eliza#23061](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23061), [elizaos/eliza#23058](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23058), [elizaos/eliza#23163](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23163), [elizaos/eliza#23169](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23169)).
*   **Lifecycle & Billing:** Implemented canonical billing snapshots, dormant account quarantine, and Google Play account deletion workflows ([elizaos/eliza#23128](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23128), [elizaos/eliza#23083](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23083), [elizaos/eliza#22854](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/22854)).

### Agent Capabilities
*   **Testing & Automation:** Improved deterministic testing via strict model fixture manifests and enabled flexible routines for personal assistant agents ([elizaos/eliza#23150](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23150), [elizaos/eliza#23049](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23049), [elizaos/eliza#23059](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/23059)).
